title: Organic Food's Dubious Cancer Benefits
summary: Physician critiques a French cohort linking organic food to less cancer, arguing wealthier, healthier organic buyers confound the result.

assertions.quote: should you encourage your patients to eat organic not on the basis of this study
people who ate a lot of organic food were substantially different than those who didn't

verdicts.note: Cohorts consistently find organic consumers have higher income, education and healthier habits, which statistical adjustment cannot fully remove.
